notes: Pass 1: five own pages read, all HTTP 200; the Sales Hub pricing page (key 99d5a60a1761b787) rendered only its title in the fetch. Names: HubSpot and HubSpot Sales Hub are the vendor's names (aliases) and were not coded; lowercase phrases such as "marketing, sales, and service hubs" were treated as descriptions. Hedged lines (can, often, generally) were not coded. Cause pages: sybill.ai carries the 1,000,000 contacts line; pipelinecrm.com carries the unlimited contacts line; sales-leads-crm.com and builts.ai do not carry either line as current (builts.ai says the free tier once had unlimited contacts and changed in 2026, but no HubSpot page dates the change); the brokenrubik.com URL redirected to an unrelated NetSuite guide. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the pricing page was read once in a real browser. It shows Starter '$7/mo/seat' and '$20/mo/seat', Professional '$90/mo/seat' and '$100/mo/seat' with billing options (Pay Monthly, Commit annually, Pay Annually marked best value), Enterprise '$150/mo/seat', required one-time onboarding of $1,500 (Professional) and $3,500 (Enterprise), included credits and extra credits at $0.010 each; edition feature lists sit behind 'See Details' and are not in the snapshot. Re-classed to true: C01, C02, C04, C05, C10, C11. C07 stays unverifiable (two unlabelled Starter prices). Consistency check: C13 and C14 stay wrong; the CRM page's free-plan limit (two users, 1,000 contacts) is explicit and like with like. Added: C34 (forecasting in paid tiers, split from the crm|5|Google AI Mode|2 line whose automation and reporting parts join C26) and the crm|5|Claude|1 'paid upgrades' line as a C26 instance; other gap and table lines are already covered from the same answers (C01, C08, C12) or are fit judgments, ratings or features. Reviewer: look first at C01 and C11, which read the $90 figure as the annual 'starts at' price because the snapshot text does not label which of $90 and $100 belongs to which billing option.
